description: A simple input-side guard normalizes style before the safety check: it asks the model to restate the request in a plain register and screens that restatement. Reported as a diagnostic that localizes the weakness to input-distribution coverage, not a complete defense.
metric: mean ASR (%) across the five targets, Style Jailbreak attack under the guard
reading: the guard brings the styled-attack success rate back down to roughly the direct-request baseline (~3%), which places the gap in input-distribution coverage and indicates where safety alignment should extend rather than an output-side filter
